race.comment: Loads of these are close to wins. SWITCH HIT (1) is a Victorian who did place in his only try at this circuit. Will find this easier than the last couple over the border on heavy ground and should be tough to stop late. TOUR DE MOON (4) has placed at both runs this time in, the latest over 1200m at Strathalbyn when third, beaten 2.75 lengths. Won't find this as tough. Likely to feature. MISS ELLANEOUS (8) made considerable ground in the run home to finish third last start over 1200m at Murtoa. Key runner who can get home hard into the finish. FOREVER WAITING (5) returned from a spell last start with a strong win by a long neck over 1100m at Naracoorte. Fitter and is among the better chances. FULL COMMITMENT (6) will find this easier and is worth keeping safe.
